summary: Iter 34 — Validated 4 sidebar/UX fixes + complete Reports module (8 PDF report types). Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass (all 8 report types reach READY in <30s, file_size>1000 bytes, %PDF header verified, download token + soft-delete + auth + Anomaly hero data all green). Frontend: Cathy login works; sidebar 5 collapsible groups all toggle correctly with sessionStorage persistence (key=wayly_nav_group_{key}); Reports page renders all 8 cards with Generate buttons; HOUSEHOLD_SUMMARY end-to-end completes in ~10s — modal opens, READY transition, View opens report-preview; config-modal works for QUARTERLY_BUDGET with cfg-submit; /ai-tools/statement-decoder wraps in Layout when logged in (primary-nav + brand-link present); Participants Edit modal opens with ProviderPicker dropdown (BlueBerry Care visible) and edit-save-btn present.
critical_code_review_comments: Provider Performance locking when <3 statements could not be exercised end-to-end because Cathy's seeded data has 8 statements; full READY report is returned instead. Locked-path code exists in builder but is not currently reachable with default seed. If you want this to be testable, consider seeding a second participant with <3 statements (or document the locking behavior as 'verified by code review only').
React duplicate-key warnings on /app dashboard originate from third-party emergent-main.js (https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js line 38) — not from Wayly code. No action needed.

Sidebar sessionStorage uses per-group keys (wayly_nav_group_today, wayly_nav_group_money, etc.), not a single composite key. This works correctly and persists across reload — just noting in case the spec implied a single key.

Reports backend correctly returns 401 for unauthenticated /api/reports/generate, returns 400 for unknown report types, soft-deletes (DELETED status filtered from list), and serves PDFs via short-lived token URL with proper Content-Type.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded Cathy/Dorothy household. Test-created reports are soft-deleted automatically (DELETED status filtered from list); no manual cleanup needed beyond stored PDF files on disk at /app/backend/storage/reports/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend reports module is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_reports.py — re-run with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_reports.py -v`. It generates one of every report type and verifies READY + PDF. Auth: button text on /login is 'Sign in' (NOT 'Log in'). Cathy logs in via POST /api/auth/login returning Bearer token. Reports run async — POST returns GENERATING within ~50ms, full READY in 5-15s for most types (Care Timeline can be slowest). PDF served at /api/reports/file/{token} with 15-min TTL. The Provider Performance locked-state UI cannot be triggered with current seed (8 statements exist). All 5 sidebar groups have data-testid=`nav-group-toggle-{today|money|care|providers|account}` — labels in UI are TODAY, MONEY & STATEMENTS, THEIR CARE, PROVIDERS & PAPERWORK, YOUR ACCOUNT.
